issues.description: Status inconsistency in notes.md: the '编译环境' section (line 7) states '状态: published' for the 2026-06-02 build, while the latest entry at the bottom states '最终状态: built' for the 2026-08-22 build. The manifest.yaml correctly says 'built'. The historical 'published' status in the body is confusing for readers assessing the current PR status, as it may appear the package claims to be published when CI has not yet run.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the '编译环境' section to reflect the current build status 'built', or add a clarifying note that the 'published' status refers to a previous build event (2026-06-02) that is superseded by the current 2026-08-22 build with status 'built'.

issues.description: The conanfile.py contains 'url = ""' which code style rule 5 lists as a template placeholder pattern ('url = ""  # CI fills this' — should be filled by adapter). Per project context, this field is a CI-filled placeholder for the recipe URL in the Conan registry, so it is functionally acceptable. Noted for style awareness only.
issues.fix_suggestion: No action required — CI fills this field automatically during publish. If desired for clarity, a brief comment '# CI fills recipe URL on publish' could be added to document the intent.

issues.description: conanfile.py lacks a shebang line (#!/usr/bin/env python3) and docstring describing the software name and build system, as required by code style rule 1. Per project context, empty shebang/docstring is acceptable for conan recipes (not standalone scripts). Noted for style consistency only.
issues.fix_suggestion: No action required for conan recipes. If desired for documentation, add: #!/usr/bin/env python3\n"""Conan recipe — postgresql-hypopg 1.4.2 (PGXS)"""

issues.description: test.sh uses 'FAIL:' and 'PASS:' output markers instead of the project convention '[step]', '[ok]', '[fail]', '[warn]' with 8-space indentation as specified in code style rule 9. The script is a test_package verification script rather than a CI build script, so the impact is minimal.
issues.fix_suggestion: If strict conformance is desired, replace 'FAIL:' with '[fail]' (8-space indented) and 'PASS:' with '        [ok]'. Otherwise acceptable as-is for test_package scripts.

issues.description: conandata.yml uses 'patches: {}' (empty YAML dict/mapping) instead of the conventional 'patches: []' (empty YAML list/sequence). Code style rule 13 shows patches as a list with '- patch_file:' items. While functionally harmless (no patches to apply), the empty dict form is unconventional for a list field.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'patches: {}' to 'patches: []' for proper YAML list semantics, or simply 'patches:' with no value (null).

issues.description: notes.md references source URL 'https://api.github.com/repos/HypoPG/hypopg/tarball/1.4.2' (GitHub API tarball format) which differs from the conandata.yml URL 'https://github.com/HypoPG/hypopg/archive/refs/tags/1.4.2.tar.gz' (archive refs/tags format). Both resolve to the same source tarball for tag 1.4.2, but the discrepancy may cause confusion.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md to reference the same URL as conandata.yml: 'https://github.com/HypoPG/hypopg/archive/refs/tags/1.4.2.tar.gz' for consistency.

summary:
PASS — No P0 (deception) or P1 (recipe quality) issues found. All 7 changed files for postgresql-hypopg 1.4.2 (branch feat/postgresql-hypopg-1.4.2) pass the audit.

Deception detection (P0): No empty shell tests (R34) — test.sh performs substantive verification of ELF magic bytes (0x7f454c46), _PG_init symbol, and hypopg symbols via readelf. No skipped/faked tests (R9). manifest.yaml status 'built' is accurate (local verify passed, CI not yet run). sha256 is valid (64 hex chars, not all zeros). No pre-compiled binaries in PR (R19). No #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs (R8). Not applicable for deep adaptation verification (R40) — hypopg is a PostgreSQL extension library, not in graphics/UI/multimedia/peripheral/system-level categories.

Recipe quality (P1): Conan 2.x API used correctly. Source URL is official GitHub (HypoPG/hypopg). No conan dependencies declared — PostgreSQL pg_config from system PATH per OHOS profile. PGXS build system (make PG_CONFIG=pg_config) correctly used instead of CMake/autotools. Method order follows standard. package_info sets cpp_info.libs. No bare shell env vars (R33). No generated files modified (R6).

File spec: All required files present (conanfile.py, conandata.yml, test_package/, manifest.yaml, notes.md). No forbidden files (.so/.a/.log/.DS_Store etc.). PR is atomic (single package only).

6 P2/P3 warnings noted (non-blocking): notes.md status inconsistency (P2), conanfile.py url placeholder and missing shebang (P3, both acceptable per project context), test.sh output format (P3), conandata.yml patches dict vs list (P3), notes.md URL discrepancy (P3).
